newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PAG buys Graphicor stake for 3.9 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: PAG buys Graphicor stake for 3.9 mln rand.

text.p: PAG Ltd said on Thursday it had bought a 50 percent stake in Graphicor (Pty) Ltd for 3.9 million rand with effect from April 1, 1996.

It said the purchase was settled by the issue of 325,000 PAG shares at an issue price of 400 cents per share and the allotment of 702,702 PAG shares at an issue price of 3.70 per share to the sellers.
PAG said an application had been made to the Johannesburg Stock Exchange to list 1,027,702 PAG shares in "Banks and Financial Services" sector on February 3.
PAG said it was its objective to expand its activities in the financial services sector with a view to establishing its position as a broadly based financial services group.
